comparison.objective: Transfer and seat a long strut around keep-outs without disturbing a sensitive housing; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-object transport, handoff/regrasp, obstacle routing, and saddle placement versus small-socket access and rotary adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Both strut ends seated with the housing never exceeding displacement/tilt limits; candidate scores dynamic stopping and lock retention.
comparison.reason: Constrained transport and regrasping are not the candidate’s tested mechanism.
